overall_assessment: The package publication and supply-chain governance framework enforces strict deny-by-default controls. All 30 workspace crates remain private (publish = false) in Cargo.toml manifests and are protected by release/public-packages.json policy checks. Pre-flight checks in scripts/submit-registries.sh require explicit opt-in confirmation and block execution when credentials or required release artifacts are absent.

findings.description: check_public_package_policy.py strictly verifies that no internal or workspace crates are declared publishable without explicit policy exemptions.
findings.recommendation: Retain this automated gate across all CI and static harness runs.

findings.description: Unit tests in test_registries_publication_governance.py validate registry schema conformance, packet presence, dry-run safety, and citation alignment.
findings.recommendation: Preserve 100% test coverage for publication governance.

findings.description: Registry targets and blockers in registry/status.json explicitly articulate the dependency on verified release availability before external publication.
findings.recommendation: Maintain honest dependency sequencing without bypassing gating requirements.

calibration_notes: Governance auditors confirm that supply-chain controls, crate privacy firewalls, and dry-run guardrails meet rigorous standards.
